svg.title: Chapter 5 detailed QoS map
svg.desc: Detailed RAG-grounded map of QoS metrics, measurement, queues, conditioning, feedback, reservation, traffic engineering and overprovisioning.
svg.text: Chapter 5 — QoS: from metrics to mechanisms
PDF 134–180 · printed 133–179 · source mode: rag_only
1. Formalize service quality
SLA = metric + threshold/range + measurement interval + ideally measurement method
Quality dimensions: performance · reliability · security; provider also cares about scalability, manageability and interoperability
2. Measure statistically
distribution / histogram
mean · median · standard deviation · CV · percentile
active probes: controlled but add traffic
passive observation: real traffic but harder timing/sync
OWD · jitter · response time · RTT
3. Characterize traffic
SIR · instantaneous rate · PIR · burst size
stream (CBR-like) vs bursty (VBR-like)
delay-sensitive · jitter-sensitive · loss-sensitive
resource utilization + burstiness drive queue behavior
as utilization approaches capacity, waiting grows sharply
4. Congestion management: queues
FIFO — simple, no traffic differentiation
Strict priority — low delay for top class, possible starvation of lower classes
Weighted queues — guaranteed capacity shares under overload
Combined scheduling — priority for delay-sensitive class + weighted treatment for others
5. Prevent overload
classification → choose class
policing → drop/downgrade excess
shaping → delay excess in a buffer
feedback → ask upstream source/node to slow
feedback delay can create stale-control effects
6. Coordinate network-wide resources
reservation → admission control along the path
traffic engineering → choose routes using load/capacity
goal: balanced utilization while meeting QoS
alternative: overprovision and keep utilization low
monitor utilization and upgrade before persistent degradation
Operational logic: requirements → metrics → measurements → bottleneck → least-complex effective control
Source limits: mathematical typography is partially extraction-damaged; figures 5.x are text-only in RAG.
